gitCommit.subject: Hide empty canvas and match workspace dot grid before image load (#1)
gitCommit.body:
Hide empty canvas and match workspace dot grid before image load (#1)

Before dropping an image, a 512×512 canvas rendered with the default white
background color, producing a visible white square on the dark workspace.

- Hide the canvas and resize handles until a source is loaded
- Defer custom canvas size until an image or video is opened
- Use fixed dark grid colors in the no-image shader branch
- Skip the render loop and keep a 1×1 buffer when no source is present

Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>
Co-authored-by: Joey Grillo <JoeyLovesPizza@users.noreply.github.com>
